releases.title: Ad hoc dashboard filters and docked alert editing
releases.summary: Dashboards gain ad hoc filters: add filters to a dashboard on the fly, have the conditions broadcast to every tile, and click a cell in a search or table tile to filter by that value without opening an editor.

highlights.text: PromQL queries resolve through their source
ClickHouse is scraped in its own clickhouse job
Ad hoc filters on any dashboard
Edit chart alerts in a docked side panel
A content font size preference
Pick any time zone, not just UTC
Heatmaps from PromQL metrics
Choose how a line is drawn between points
Group by on the search page histogram
Tile descriptions
Author dashboards and saved searches from the CLI
PromQL tiles in the external Dashboards API
Group-by values in webhook body templates
clickstack_sql can target a source
A per-service health report in one MCP call
The service map remembers your sampling rate
SeverityNumber and EventName expressions on log sources

releases.title: Query attribution and a session secret change
releases.summary: Every ClickHouse query HyperDX runs — PromQL included — is now tagged with the part of the product that issued it, so a row in `system.query_log` tells you which dashboard, tile, search or alert put that load on your cluster.

highlights.text: The API no longer signs sessions with a public default secret
AI assistant calls are traced with the GenAI semantic conventions
Attribute ClickHouse queries to the dashboard, search or alert behind them
Minimum auto granularity on PromQL sources
A series limit for PromQL charts
A series mode for builder heatmaps
Stacked line charts
Single-select dashboard filters
A PromQL variable format that escapes to suit the filter
Choose how property keys are ordered in the row side panel
Label each instance in the tab title and sidebar

releases.title: Trace logs tab and multi-expression PromQL
releases.summary: The event side panel now has a "Trace logs" tab, listing a trace's logs as a flat chronological table instead of leaving you to hunt for them among the spans in the waterfall.

highlights.text: A "Trace logs" tab in the event side panel
Choose what a click on a search result does
MATERIALIZED and ALIAS columns in the row details panel
Plot several PromQL expressions on one chart
PromQL number tiles take instant queries and reductions
Sparklines behind PromQL number tiles
Table tiles on PromQL sources
Pie and bar tiles on PromQL sources
Macros in PromQL charts
Markdown tiles pick up dashboard variables
A per-source floor for auto granularity
StatsD metrics from your own collector pipeline

releases.title: Chart label clipping and image build fixes
releases.summary: This release unblocks the all-in-one and local Docker images, which copied node's entire `/usr/lib` over the ClickHouse base image and stopped building altogether once the two landed on different Alpine point releases.

releases.title: Chart alerts and required dashboard filters
releases.summary: You can now create an alert directly from a chart in the explorer, without first saving it to a dashboard tile or a saved search — build the query, add an alert, and it carries its own chart config with it.

highlights.text: PromQL against ClickHouse now goes through its Prometheus HTTP API
Alerts straight from the chart explorer
Dashboard filters can be marked required
Dashboards remember relative date ranges
Span metrics from your own collector pipeline
Filter the LLM dashboard by end user
Pick rows out of the search results table
Stored third-party tokens can be encrypted at rest
A getting-started checklist in the sidebar
Dashboard tile alerts can be exported to Terraform
